# syntax = docker/dockerfile:1

# Adjust NODE_VERSION as desired
ARG NODE_VERSION=18.20.4
FROM node:${NODE_VERSION}-slim AS base

LABEL fly_launch_runtime="Next.js"

# Next.js app lives here
WORKDIR /app

# Set production environment
ENV NODE_ENV="production"

# Install pnpm
ARG PNPM_VERSION=8.15.4
RUN npm install -g pnpm@$PNPM_VERSION


# Throw-away build stage to reduce size of final image
FROM base AS build

# Install packages needed to build node modules
RUN apt-get update -qq && \
    apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y build-essential node-gyp pkg-config python-is-python3

# Install node modules
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prod=false

# Copy application code
COPY . .

# Build application
RUN pnpm run build

# Remove development dependencies
RUN pnpm prune --prod


# Final stage for app image
FROM base

# Copy built application
COPY --from=build /app /app

# Start the server by default, this can be overwritten at runtime
EXPOSE 3000
CMD [ "pnpm", "run", "start" ]

-- Migration: Add analytics and reporting tables
-- Description: Create tables for storing analytics data and reports
-- Author: HR Admin
-- Created: 2023-12-22

-- create reporting period enum type
create type reporting_period as enum ('daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'quarterly', 'yearly');

-- create report_types table to categorize different types of reports
create table if not exists report_types (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  name text not null unique,
  description text,
  is_enabled boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- create saved_reports table for storing report configurations
create table if not exists saved_reports (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  name text not null,
  description text,
  report_type_id uuid references report_types(id) on delete cascade,
  filters jsonb, -- stores filter configurations as JSON
  created_by uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
  is_public boolean not null default false,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- create analytics_metrics table for tracking key metrics over time
create table if not exists analytics_metrics (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  metric_name text not null,
  metric_value numeric not null,
  metric_date date not null,
  period reporting_period not null,
  dimension text, -- optional dimension for categorization (e.g., department, project)
  dimension_value text, -- value of the dimension
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- create analytics_dashboards table for custom dashboard configurations
create table if not exists analytics_dashboards (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  name text not null,
  description text,
  layout jsonb, -- stores dashboard layout configuration
  created_by uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
  is_public boolean not null default false,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- create dashboard_widgets table for individual widgets on dashboards
create table if not exists dashboard_widgets (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  dashboard_id uuid references analytics_dashboards(id) on delete cascade,
  widget_type text not null, -- e.g., 'chart', 'metric', 'table'
  title text not null,
  config jsonb, -- stores widget configuration (chart type, data source, etc.)
  position_x integer not null default 0,
  position_y integer not null default 0,
  width integer not null default 1,
  height integer not null default 1,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- create data_exports table to track data export history
create table if not exists data_exports (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  export_type text not null, -- e.g., 'employees', 'projects', 'allocations'
  filters jsonb, -- stores filter configurations used for the export
  exported_by uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
  file_format text not null, -- e.g., 'csv', 'xlsx', 'pdf'
  row_count integer,
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- create analytics_logs table for tracking feature usage
create table if not exists analytics_logs (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  user_id uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
  action text not null, -- e.g., 'view_report', 'export_data', 'create_dashboard'
  resource_type text, -- e.g., 'report', 'dashboard', 'metric'
  resource_id uuid, -- ID of the resource being acted upon
  details jsonb, -- additional information about the action
  created_at timestamp with time zone default now()
);

-- create triggers for all new tables with updated_at column
create trigger update_report_types_modified
before update on report_types
for each row execute function update_modified_column();

create trigger update_saved_reports_modified
before update on saved_reports
for each row execute function update_modified_column();

create trigger update_analytics_metrics_modified
before update on analytics_metrics
for each row execute function update_modified_column();

create trigger update_analytics_dashboards_modified
before update on analytics_dashboards
for each row execute function update_modified_column();

create trigger update_dashboard_widgets_modified
before update on dashboard_widgets
